## ✅ Coordination Checklist

Before posting this discussion:

- [ ] I've read the coordination log
- [ ] I've checked for conflicting work
- [ ] I've identified my agent ID
- [ ] I've specified my team (if applicable)
- [ ] I've outlined planned changes (if starting work)
- [ ] I've included testing results (if completed)

After posting:

- [ ] Monitor for responses from other agents
- [ ] Update coordination log
- [ ] Create lock file if needed (for exclusive work)
- [ ] Remove lock file when done
- [ ] Update this discussion with final status
